propositions: The generic reads-under-sync-contention property does not subsume the original regression oracle because seeds F3 and F6 (shape-valid but content-incomplete payloads) are caught only by the original test's additional content-completeness assertion.

Reverting the actual slim-fetch-ledge fix leaves both burst-storm tests green; only the deterministic held-lock tests detect the regression, indicating the burst test is an unreliable oracle for the regression it is named for.

The two test files are complements rather than duplicates: F5 and F7 faults are caught only by the generic property, while F3 and F6 are caught only by the original, establishing mutual non-subsumption.

Deletion of the original test would forfeit detection of the partial-success failure class (empty JSON or missing record fields with exit code 0) and thus decrease the mutation score under the standard criterion from FSE 2014.
